notes.title: Variable speed changes, enhanced gods bless, and text updates
notes.content:
Enhance the divine gift strength of genres like Crystal Guardian and Money Flow, now you can enjoy the Endless Mode even more!
Combat speed change removed from high speed, now the maximum speed is 3 times faster. Left click to accelerate, right click to decelerate
Update game text, fix error display

notes.content:
Bringing out monsters early now will reduce the CD of active skills
Before the first wave of monsters arrives, sell heroes and return all the gold coins
Change font, add new UI, adjust UI
Adjusting Endless Mode Difficulty

notes.title: Optimize the talent system and skill effects
notes.content:
Optimize the talent system and skill effects

Fix the bug where talents are learned out of sequence.

notes.title: Optimize the upgrade logic of hero skills and optimize the knockback effect
notes.content:
Optimize the upgrade logic of hero skills and optimize the knockback effect

Now you can click to upgrade the hero's skills, and the skill introduction will be displayed in floating mode
Now the knockback effect is not that far off the track

notes.title: Add language, fix bugs, add restrictions
notes.content:
Add language, fix bugs, add restrictions

Increase animation speed.
Fix the issue where content inside the UI box is not fully displayed.
Fix the overlapping display issue in the backpack.
Add seven languages including Polish, Ukrainian, and Italian.
Optimize the logic for enemies damaging the crystal.
Add a cap to certain divine gifts, limiting their enhancement/damage.
Endless enemies now gradually become stronger, reflected in their health, movement speed, and gold.
Limit poison fire damage; now the maximum flame damage is 100 and poison damage is 200.
Improve enemy state initialization.
Add null checks for talents and divine gifts, preventing attacks from lingering in the air.
Display the number of resets for divine gifts.
In battle scenes, pressing the space bar now pauses the game.
Optimize the battle menu button logic.
